steps.name: setup: the test store is manual-confirm for this run (restored afterwards)
setup: the deployed candidate reads the minted booker session as role booker
A1 deployed agreement-check hands the owner the current policy hash and reports the agreement active
A2 deployed agreement-sign refuses a stale displayed hash (409 policy_changed with the current text) and writes nothing
A3 deployed agreement-sign with the current hash replays the live agreement (no new row)
A4 deployed agreement-sign without a displayed hash is refused (400 policy_hash_required)

detail.message: Reload the store's policies and agree again.

steps.name: A5 deployed agreement-sign by the booker is refused (403 role_not_allowed)

detail.message: Only the brand account owner can agree to a store's policies. Ask them to agree once, then you can book here.

steps.name: T1 deployed booker-accept refuses a Terms version other than the required one (409 terms_version_mismatch) before touching any invitation

detail.message: Demohub's Terms of Service changed while this page was open. Reload the page to review the current terms.

steps.name: T2 deployed booker-accept refuses an acceptance without the Terms box (400 terms_required)

detail.message: Tick the box to accept Demohub's Terms of Service.

steps.name: B1 the booker books one demo with an operation key (manual-confirm store): pending payment, attributed to the booker
B2 the SAME request with the SAME key replays the same booking: one booking, one operation row, replay flagged, no checkout touched
B3 a CHANGED request under the same key is refused (409 op_key_reused), still one booking

detail.message: This request was already used for a different booking. Reload and try again.

steps.name: B4 the owner replaying the booker's key is refused (409 op_key_reused)

detail.message: This request was already used for a different booking. Reload and try again.

steps.name: P1 checkout returns a Stripe test-mode session for the booker's booking
P2 the test card pays on Stripe's hosted page and returns to the preview
P3 the webhook marks the booking paid and it WAITS for the store (manual-confirm): status pending, $30.00
C1 the store's confirm action confirms the paid booking
C2 the worker fans out the store notices; no store notice in the outbox addresses the booker
C3 the receipt for the booker's payment goes to the owner AND to the booker who paid, both accepted
R1 the owner revokes the booker
R2 after revocation the booker's replay of the paid booking's key and a fresh booking are both refused (401), and no booker session remains
R3 the paid, confirmed booking is untouched by the revocation and still attributed to the revoked member
X1 the store cancels: booking cancelled, payment refunded, one Stripe test refund of $30.00 succeeded on the booker's payment
X2 the cancellation notice reaches the store contact; no store notice ever addressed the booker
